headline: Nigerian Naira Weakens to N1,397/$ as Interbank Turnover Surges
summary: Interbank foreign exchange turnover in Nigeria rose 328% to $702.63 million as the naira weakened to N1,397 per dollar, its lowest closing level since March.
why: Currency depreciation against the US dollar increases import costs and inflationary pressures in developing economies reliant on foreign goods.

impacts.name: Nigerian Naira
impacts.why: Increased interbank transaction volume accompanied a drop in the naira's exchange value.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A sharp rise in interbank dollar demand coincided with the naira dropping to its weakest closing level in months.
